responsibility: Defines the TS_* tree-structure enumeration that classifies the concrete storage layouts within GCC’s union tree_node. Each DEFTREESTRUCT entry names one structural variant, such as specific constant, decl, type, expression, SSA, block, constructor, or option layouts; these identifiers are used by generated code and tables such as tree_contains_struct, by garbage collection and PCH support to know which fields a node layout contains, and by the tree subsystem to map tree codes onto the underlying node structure they use.
